expr: (let allSubseq (arr : Array Int) := (arr.foldl fun acc x => acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse; let subseqA := allSubseq a; let subseqB := allSubseq b; let commonSubseqLens := subseqA.filter (fun l => subseqB.contains l) |>.map (·.length); commonSubseqLens.foldl max (commonSubseqLens.headD 0))

lemmas.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (a b : Array Int) (h : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b), LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond a b (let allSubseq (arr : Array Int) := (arr.foldl fun acc x => acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse; let subseqA := allSubseq a; let subseqB := allSubseq b; let commonSubseqLens := subseqA.filter (fun l => subseqB.contains l) |>.map (·.length); commonSubseqLens.foldl max (commonSubseqLens.headD 0)) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro a b h
  unfold LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond
  exact Refine.maxlist_int _ (List.ne_nil_of_mem (a := 0) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨[], List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(List.mem_map.mpr ⟨[], Refine.allsub_nil_mem_arr a, rfl⟩), List.contains_iff_mem.mpr (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨[], Refine.allsub_nil_mem_arr b, rfl⟩)⟩, rfl⟩))
